needs.semantics: Grants a PARAMETERISED landwalk to a target. The bare `landwalk` keyword carries no land type, and characteristics.ts:545 builds the walk types from `attacker.def.landwalk` plus an anthem static's `landwalk` list only, so nothing an effect grants can ever make a creature unblockable today. The op would push the land types into the same per-object bag `staticMods().landwalk` already feeds.
